verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs claim an 'AI Modeler' that builds financial models in plain language with no formulas, and AI running inside the model to answer questions. That is a first-party natural-language capability, but it is shown only in two short marketing lines and scoped to modeling and answers, not to operating the product broadly. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands cover broader product operation (data connections, scenarios, reporting, permissions), detailed docs on supported commands and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
